answer: Require each identity to escrow a 520-unit bond and serve a twenty-seven epoch probation. Every round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for eleven rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 520 units per alias and replays twenty-seven rounds, while a quill signature traces authorship, comet receipts catch replays, and orchard routing scatters tasks.
